name: Crusader's Armory
summary: Munitions fill the Crusader's Armory in the Scarlet Monastery. Narrow halls hold gunpowder and cannonballs for the zealots guarding the way inward. A locked iron door bars the path to the Hall of Champions.

sections.title: Arsenal of Zeal
sections.body: Between the Footman's Armory and the Hall of Champions, narrow stone corridors hold crates of gunpowder and stacks of cannonballs. Armed crusaders stand ready to turn back intruders. The Scarlet Crusade has made a fortress of a former monastic compound, filling every available hall with the tools of war. A heavy iron door, locked with the Scarlet Key, bars the way into the inner chambers.

faq.answer: The Crusader's Armory holds ammunition in the passage between the Footman's Armory and the Hall of Champions, within the Scarlet Monastery's Armory wing.

faq.q: Why is the door at the end locked?
faq.answer: The locked door guards the passage to the Hall of Champions and the commander's quarters beyond. The Scarlet Crusade requires the Scarlet Key from the Monastery's Library wing to open it.

faq.q: Why are there so many cannonballs and gunpowder crates here?
faq.answer: The Scarlet Crusade stores cannonballs and gunpowder here for its cannons and explosive ordnance. Its active siege presence and artillery defenses across Tirisfal Glades need steady supplies for war against the Scourge and Forsaken.
Seasoned Scarlet Crusade soldiers guard the hall among the munitions, including footmen, crusaders, and archers. They stop invaders trying to push deeper into the complex.

angles.text: For the Forsaken and the Horde, the explosive stores in the Crusader's Armory threaten Tirisfal Glades' borders and the gates of the Undercity.
The weapons and munitions stockpiled here show the high production value and military discipline of Lordaeron's former smiths, now given to zealous fanaticism.
